# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.0.x   | :x:                |
| [convert-kana](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.shotadft/convert-kana) | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/shotadft/KanaConverter/issues)
or contact the maintainer on X(Old Twitter) ([@shotadft](https://x.com/shotadft)).

We will respond as quickly as possible and coordinate a fix.
